svg.title: sovrn art
svg.desc: The wordmark cut out of the programme's own on-chain identifiers: the 15 contracts and inscriptions behind CENTS, Reflection, Nine Reflections, Wunderkammer, Painting with Fire: a history in GANs, Noctilucent Mementi, Possibility Spaces, Sightseers: Perimeter Town, Seasons of Mobility, Latent Couture, byteGANs, RABBIT TAKEOVER, SIGHTSEERS, cope. Vol 1, AI Spaceships. The technique is taken from Reflection, where the painted forms are filled with the owner's wallet address rather than with colour.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace
